source.book: 剑桥KET青少版官方真题3（参考答案&音频文稿小册扫描版）
source.pages: 小册 PNG 1-9（书页 84-92，Test 1 answer key + Transcript）

parts.1:
Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
Question 1
One. What will they have for lunch?
Boy: Are we having sandwiches for our family lunch on the beach, Mum?
Mum: We usually do that, I know. Why don't we have a barbecue this time?
Boy: Or perhaps some fish and chips at the café there? They always smell fantastic.
Mum: You're right, but that'll be quite expensive for eight of us.
Boy: OK. Your idea sounds good.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. Which sport is the girl going to play this term?
Boy: This term I'm doing volleyball for the first time. How about you?
Girl: I really enjoy volleyball – you will too. But my teacher's put my name on the list for hockey, and I'm not sure I'll like it.
Boy: Maybe not. I think basketball's a good sport for you. You're tall and run really fast.
Girl: Well, perhaps I can do that another term!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Where will the friends go first?
Matt: Shall we work on our project together at the city library this afternoon, Bella?
Bella: OK, Matt, but before that I've got to collect my new glasses from the shop.
Matt: That's no problem – because then we can go to that café next door. They sell great cakes.
Bella: Good idea. And it's only ten minutes to walk to the library from there.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. How does the girl get to school now?
Uncle Jack: You're looking well, Amy! Are you still riding your bike to school?
Amy: Well, it's really good exercise for me, Uncle Jack, I know, but it's hard in winter. So I've started leaving home early and walking there. I caught the bus once, but it was so noisy!
Uncle Jack: The bus is much faster.
Amy: But slower than by bike actually.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. What do they decide to buy for their mother?
Boy: What shall we get Mum for her birthday this year?
Girl: Well, she loved the necklace we got her last year. How about some other jewellery? I saw some nice silver earrings at the market.
Boy: Mm. That's not a bad idea. Or we could buy a bracelet?
Girl: She doesn't often wear those.
Boy: OK, then. Let's get what you suggested.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a girl called Mandy leaving a phone message for a friend about spending Sunday at the beach.
Mandy: Hi! I'm ringing about going to the beach on Sunday. There's no train that day, but there's a bus which stops outside the beach café, so we're getting that.
I wanted to take my guitar but Mum says no – so bring your kite instead please.
For lunch, we're going to have a picnic. My mum doesn't like eating on the beach but there's a park. We'll eat there and perhaps go to the shopping centre afterwards for half an hour.
Last time we were at the beach, we had a football match, remember? This time I've booked for us to play volleyball. It'll be fun.
We can go on a boat trip too. A ticket is usually four pounds fifty, but there's a discount on Sunday and it's only three seventy-five. That's nearly a pound cheaper.
You're invited to dinner at my house. We'll leave the beach at quarter past five. Then we'll be back at my place at six thirty which is great because my family usually eat at quarter to seven.
Bye!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear two friends, Ned and Aisha, talking about their first week at a new school.
Aisha: So, Ned. What did you think of our first week at the new school?
Ned: OK. I'm so happy we sat next to each other in our first class, Aisha. We live in the same street so I'm surprised we haven't met before.
Aisha: Yes, and lunchtime was fun.
Ned: Did you feel a bit worried before you started at the new school?
Aisha: I felt excited actually.
Ned: Me too. Not scared at all. My brother says we're lucky because it's an awesome school.
Aisha: Well, the building doesn't look great.
Ned: I know, but all the kids in our class are lovely.
Aisha: Most are but not everyone. But I like all our teachers. They do lots to help us.
Ned: That's true. Which subject do you like best?
Aisha: In my old school it was maths but geography's my favourite now. History's the only subject I don't enjoy much.
Ned: The only thing I don't like is homework. It takes at least two hours every evening.
Aisha: Really? I only spend an hour. It's not usually very difficult.
Ned: Well, we didn't get so much in my old school.
Aisha: We got very little at mine as well.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about a book. How did the boy get the book?
Girl: Oh, I've read that book. It's really good.
Boy: It's strange – I was looking at it in a bookshop a few days ago, but didn't have enough money to get it. So I was really pleased when it was given to me as a prize yesterday. I was first in the running race!
Girl: Fantastic!
Boy: I'll lend it to my cousin after I've read it.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a girl talking to her father about a lesson. What type of lesson did she have?
Dad: How was your first lesson?
Girl: It was OK, Dad, but the teacher spent ages talking about our hands, and where we have to put them.
Dad: Well, the way you hold an instrument is important, isn't it?
Girl: Yeah. And you can make lots of different sounds, depending on where you put your fingers. But playing is difficult. My fingers really hurt afterwards!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear a boy telling his friend about his next holiday. Where will the boy stay on holiday?
Boy: I'm really looking forward to my holiday. We're going to France again.
Girl: Your grandmother has a house there, hasn't she?
Boy: Yeah, but there are so many of us visiting her this summer that I'll have to camp in her garden.
Girl: Well, it's fun to sleep outside. If her house is so popular, she should turn it into a hotel!
Boy: That's what she says!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a teacher talking to his class. What does he want his class to do now?
Teacher: OK, you've now each prepared answers to the maths questions. I'd like you to work with a partner and compare what you wrote. If you haven't got the same answers, look at your work carefully together and decide who's right. Then we'll discuss things as a class before starting the next section in your book – that's all about shapes.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about their plans for Saturday. What are they going to do together on Saturday?
Boy: My cousin's visiting my family this weekend. We're going to have a walk in the forest with my mum. Would you like to join us for that on Saturday?
Girl: Brilliant, I'll cycle over to yours after breakfast on Saturday. The forest is lovely in autumn and it's the perfect time for collecting mushrooms.
Boy: Then stay and have dinner with us.
Girl: Thanks.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear a boy telling his mum about the jobs his friends would like to do. Which job would each friend like to do?
Mum: How was your day?
Boy: Interesting, we talked about what we want to do after we leave school.
Mum: I know Alex's dad is a teacher. Is that what he wants to be?
Boy: That's what everyone in our class thought, but he goes to the theatre a lot – and wants to be in plays.
Mum: And Sally?
Boy: Well, she loves history – she's going to show people our town and tell them about it. The visitors will learn lots!
Mum: What about Peter? Is he going to help his dad look after all their animals?
Boy: That's right – I hope he still has time for cooking – he loves it!
Mum: And Amy's so good at playing the guitar.
Boy: I know, but she really wants to help children learn how to dance.
Mum: What about Tom? He plays the piano really well.
Boy: Yes, and loves being in the kitchen. He hopes to make the meals in a hotel.
Mum: And what about, Jane? She likes helping people. Does she want to be a doctor?
Boy: Actually, she'd like to spend all day looking at people's teeth!
Mum: Great!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 男孩最后说 "OK. Your idea sounds good."，接受的是妈妈提出的方案，也就是 "Why don't we have a barbecue this time?"，因此选择 A。鱼和薯条是男孩自己提的备选，被妈妈以 "that'll be quite expensive for eight of us" 否掉；三明治只是这个家庭平时的惯例，对应问句里的干扰画面。
explanations.p1q2: 女孩说 "my teacher's put my name on the list for hockey"，老师已把她列入 hockey（曲棍球）名单，因此选择 B。volleyball 是两人都喜欢、但男孩这学期才第一次玩的项目；basketball 是男孩的建议，女孩想留到 "another term" 再说，各对应另一幅图。
explanations.p1q3: Bella 说 "before that I've got to collect my new glasses from the shop"，去图书馆做 project 之前要先取眼镜，因此选择 A。图书馆是之后的目的地；取完眼镜还要顺路去隔壁咖啡馆吃蛋糕，都不是第一站。
explanations.p1q4: Amy 说 "So I've started leaving home early and walking there"，她现在改成了步行上学，因此选择 C。骑自行车那幅图对应她以前的方式，冬天太难坚持；公交车对应 "I caught the bus once, but it was so noisy!"，她只坐过一次就嫌吵。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩提议 "I saw some nice silver earrings at the market"，男孩最后说 "Let's get what you suggested."，即按女孩的建议买耳环，因此选择 B。手镯是男孩的替代提议，被 "She doesn't often wear those." 否掉；项链是去年已经送过的礼物。
explanations.p2q1: Mandy 本想带吉他，但 "Mum says no – so bring your kite instead please"，她让朋友改带风筝，因此填 kite。
explanations.p2q2: 午餐安排是野餐：妈妈不喜欢在海滩上吃饭，但 "there's a park. We'll eat there"，因此填 park；购物中心是饭后可能顺路去的地方，不是吃午饭的地点。
explanations.p2q3: Mandy 说 "This time I've booked for us to play volleyball"，这次订的是排球，因此填 volleyball；上次在海滩踢足球（football match）是干扰信息。
explanations.p2q4: 船票平时是 "four pounds fifty"，但周日有折扣，"it's only three seventy-five"，即每人 £3.75，因此填 3.75。
explanations.p2q5: Mandy 说下午 5:15 离开海滩，然后 "we'll be back at my place at six thirty"，到她家是 6:30，因此填 6:30（six thirty）；她家通常 quarter to seven 开饭，只是解释 6:30 方便，不是答案。
explanations.p3q1: Ned 说 "we sat next to each other in our first class"，又说住在同一条街却 "surprised we haven't met before"，说明此前从未见过面，第一次见面是在一节课上，因此选 B。
explanations.p3q2: Aisha 说自己 "I felt excited actually"，Ned 回答 "Me too. Not scared at all."，所以开学前 Ned 的感受也是 excited，因此选 B。scared 被他明确否认；lucky 是他哥哥评价学校的说法。
explanations.p3q3: Aisha 说 "I like all our teachers. They do lots to help us."，Ned 回应 "That's true."，两人一致认为老师很友善、乐于帮忙，因此选 A。同学是 "Most are but not everyone"，并非个个都好；校舍 "doesn't look great"，谈不上漂亮。
explanations.p3q4: Aisha 说旧学校最喜欢 maths，但现在 "geography's my favourite now. History's the only subject I don't enjoy much."，她唯一不太喜欢的科目是 history，因此选 C。
explanations.p3q5: Ned 说 "we didn't get so much in my old school."，Aisha 也说 "We got very little at mine as well."，两人都说旧学校的作业比现在少，因此选 A。耗时上 Ned 说至少两小时、Aisha 只花一小时，说法不一致，B 不成立；Aisha 说作业 "not usually very difficult"，C 不对。
explanations.p4q1: 男孩说在书店看到过这本书但 "didn't have enough money to get it"，后来 "it was given to me as a prize yesterday. I was first in the running race!"，书是跑步比赛第一名的奖品，因此选 B。他没买成，也不是向家人借的。
explanations.p4q2: 女孩说 "you can make lots of different sounds, depending on where you put your fingers"，靠手指按的位置发出不同声音、课后手指会疼，说明是吉他课，因此选 A。网球课和舞蹈课都不会这样讨论手指的用法。
explanations.p4q3: 男孩说今年夏天去看祖母的人太多，"I'll have to camp in her garden"，只能睡在她花园的帐篷里，因此选 C。房子确实是祖母的，但男孩不住在房子里。
explanations.p4q4: 老师说数学题的答案大家已经各自准备好，现在 "I'd like you to work with a partner and compare what you wrote"，即两人一组核对答案，因此选 C。数学题已完成，不是现在才开始做；书中下一节（关于 shapes）是之后才学的内容。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩邀请女孩 "join us for that on Saturday"，that 指的是 "We're going to have a walk in the forest"，两人周六一起在森林散步，因此选 C。骑车只是女孩来男孩家的交通方式；做饭不是女孩参与的事，是男孩家请她吃晚饭。
explanations.p5q1: Sally 喜欢历史，"she's going to show people our town and tell them about it"，要带游客游览小镇并讲解，对应 tour guide，因此选 H。她不是要教孩子，也没有提到登台表演。
explanations.p5q2: 妈妈问 Peter 是不是要 "help his dad look after all their animals?"，男孩确认 "That's right"，帮家里照料一群动物对应农场主 farmer，因此选 E。会做饭只是男孩希望他保留的爱好，不是职业方向。
explanations.p5q3: 妈妈夸 Amy 吉他弹得好，但男孩说她 "really wants to help children learn how to dance"，她想做的是教孩子跳舞，对应 teacher，因此选 G。会弹吉他只是她的特长，音乐表演不是她的志向。
explanations.p5q4: 妈妈提到 Tom 钢琴弹得好，男孩说他 "loves being in the kitchen. He hopes to make the meals in a hotel."，想在酒店里做菜，对应厨师 chef，因此选 B。钢琴弹得好只是妈妈的印象，不是他想做的工作。
explanations.p5q5: 妈妈猜 Jane 想当医生，但男孩说 "she'd like to spend all day looking at people's teeth!"，整天看别人的牙齿对应牙医 dentist，因此选 C。"likes helping people" 是医生这一猜测的来源，看牙齿才是关键信息。
